nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ A. Entry. No greeting: the supervisor owns the opening. Working state is reset here so a second request in the same call starts clean; a caller who comes back mid-task resumes at the step they left, with its state. The confirmation goes to the number already confirmed on this call, or else to the number the caller is calling from; either way its last three digits are confirmed before sending. ------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Find booking
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ B. Find the booking. E93: one lookup with no channel filter returns bookings made by phone, WhatsApp, the website and at the branch. E94: the same lookup answers "did I already book?". The booking system matches every filter it is given, so the filters a lookup does not use are cleared before the call, and it refuses a call with no filter at all (ON_FAILURE). It returns bookings from the start of today: one that is still to come, one whose car is at the centre today, and one that was missed today (P13). A reference the caller picked from several bookings must give exactly one booking; if it does not, that counts as a failed pick, so the which-car question stays bounded. ------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Centre start
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ F. Change the centre (E97): the booking is replaced with a new one. The new slot is held, the change is read back, and after the caller's yes one call asks the booking system to make the new booking in place of the old one. The booking system does both in one transaction: the car never has two bookings and never has none. It keeps the jobs, the advisor and the pick-up of the replaced booking, because this agent does not send them again. The service code and the contact are sent again as the booking system returned them, and the notes are sent again in full with what this call added. Nothing is cancelled by this agent as part of a change of centre. ------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ I. The message: the confirmation after every change and again on request (E126, E99), and the cancellation message after a cancellation (Q06). The last three digits of the number are confirmed first; another number is accepted. Whether confirmations go by SMS or WhatsApp is still open (Q08, owned by the service booking agent), so no channel is chosen here: the notify service applies its configured default. It does not fall back by itself, so a message that did not go out on WhatsApp is sent once more by SMS. ------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.title: Escape safety
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ L. Escapes. The reason and the summary are set in the steps before the hand-off step. The hand-off step sets the flag and hands the call over in the same step: the flow never completes with a flag raised, because completing would return the call to the supervisor and the caller would reach nobody. The handover agent does the transfer (or offers a callback, or closes the demo), so the lines here say what happened and promise nothing, the shared system-trouble phrase included. No closing question is asked on an escape: the next agent speaks. ------------------------------------------------------------------
